sections.heading: Objective
sections.rationale: The generic objective ('explain and apply observation and scientific thinking ideas') is not assessable; replaced by two specific objectives.

sections.heading: Teacher Explanation
sections.rationale: Placeholder that describes what to teach without teaching it.

sections.heading: Worked Example
sections.rationale: Placeholder ('Model one complete science example…'); replaced by two worked examples.

sections.heading: Guided Practice
sections.rationale: Placeholder; replaced by guided sorting and a misconception check.

sections.heading: Independent Practice
sections.rationale: Placeholder; replaced by unscaffolded items and a hands-on recording task.

sections.heading: Assessment
sections.rationale: Placeholder; replaced by an exit ticket with reviewer-only keys and rubrics.

sections.heading: Remediation
sections.rationale: Generic remediation is replaced by prerequisite diagnostics with named fallback routes.

sections.heading: Extension
sections.rationale: Replaced by the optional measurement-uncertainty extension in the assessment definitions.

sections.heading: Guardian Support
sections.rationale: A home-observation suggestion belongs in teacher and guardian notes.

sections.heading: Metadata
sections.rationale: Catalogue metadata shown as learner text.
